Worklocation: Diegem/Machelen   travelling 30%

Jobomschrijving

Our customer was established in 1968 and is a part of a big Automotive Corporation in Japan.  The Brussels office is the headquarters of 8 branches in France, Germany, Poland, Czech, Turkey, Italy and Hungary.  They are urgently looking for a Business Developer E-Mobility Supply Chain. With experience in Purchase,  in automotive sector. This position involves real trading activities and business transactions with partners across Asia (including Japan). They are looking for a dynamic Business Developer who can accelerate this process, drive growth, and coordinate projects effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

• Business Development & Supply Chain
• Build and strengthen relationships with Asian automotive suppliers.
• Manage commercial activities, customer communication, logistics, and cost calculations.
• Identify and onboard new manufacturing partners.
• Support procurement activities, including supplier evaluation, negotiations, and QCD (Quality, Cost, Delivery) management.
• Electrification & Market Development
• Develop new business opportunities for battery-related materials and EV components.
• Conduct market research and identify emerging technologies and innovative companies.
• Explore strategic partnerships and investment opportunities.
• Strategy & Market Intelligence
• Monitor market and competitor developments.
• Support business growth strategies and market-entry initiatives.
• Collaborate with international teams to align regional and global objectives.

Your Profile:

• Bachelor's degree (Master's is a plus).
• Fluent in English.
• Experience in procurement, purchasing, sales, or business development; previous experience within the company is a strong asset.
• Familiarity with Genchi Genbutsu and Kaizen principles is a plus.
• Technical or engineering background preferred, or a strong interest in business development.
• Strong communication and negotiation skills in an international environment.
• Proficient in MS Office and other business software.
• Your Competencies
• Customer-oriented, positive, and proactive mindset.
• Strong analytical and business acumen.
• Able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Fast learner with a growth mindset.
• Flexible and comfortable working across cultures.
• Team player who takes ownership and follows tasks through to completion.

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for orderpicker for the Bleckmann Ghent. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters

• Departure at 5u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

jobs.occupation: Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN to strengthen its Customer Service team on a temporary basis. Acting as a key liaison between customers and internal stakeholders, the successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring an efficient order-to-cash process while delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international manufacturing and distribution company recognised for its commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Operating across multiple markets, the organisation offers a fast-paced and collaborative environment where teamwork and continuous improvement drive success.

Description

As a Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN your responsibilities are:

• Manage the complete order-to-cash process for a portfolio of domestic and international customers.
• Process, release, and monitor customer orders received through various channels, including e-commerce platforms, email, phone, and EDI.
• Provide customers with timely updates regarding order status, product availability, pricing, promotions, shipment tracking, and related documentation.
• Maintain accurate customer purchase order records within the ERP system for compliance and audit purposes.
• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain and Planning teams to validate customer demand against inventory availability.
• Manage backorders proactively and communicate alternative solutions when supply shortages arise.
• Coordinate shipments from multiple production sites and third-party suppliers while ensuring on-time delivery.
• Prepare and verify shipping, export, and customer-specific documentation.
• Handle debit and credit note administration.
• Respond to customer enquiries and manage claims related to logistics, quality, pricing, warranty, transport, and other service issues.
• Escalate complex cases according to internal procedures and ensure prompt resolution.
• Work cross-functionally with Sales, Logistics, Finance, Compliance, Marketing, and Product teams.
• Produce operational reports and analyse business data to support decision-making.
• Identify opportunities for process optimisation and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support the implementation of best practices and departmental performance standards.

A successful Customer Service & Order Administration Specialist FR/EN should have:

• Holds a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• Has initial experience within Customer Service, Customer Support, Order Management, Sales Administration, or Supply Chain Administration.
• Is fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Possesses a good working knowledge of French.
• Additional language skills are considered a strong asset.
• Has experience working with ERP systems, ideally SAP SD (Sales & Distribution).
• Demonstrates excellent proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.
• Has strong communication, organisation, and stakeholder management skills.
• Is customer-focused and solutions-oriented.
• Can work independently while also being an effective team player.
• Remains calm and efficient in a fast-paced environment.
• Displays strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
• Adopts a continuous improvement mindset and strives for service excellence.

For our client, an international player within logistics with several branches worldwide and in Belgium, we are looking for a GL Accountant.

They offer various logistics solutions through their extensive network of offices, partners and warehouses.

They are looking to strengthen their team in Antwerp and are looking for a GL Accountant.

Jobomschrijving

For the position as GL Accountant at our client in the Antwerp region, we are looking for someone who is fascinated by the following range of tasks:

• You will process the complete accounting for the assigned companies and countries.
• You prepare the monthly and annual financial close of the assigned entities.
• You align accounting and operational processes.
• You will be responsible for the balance sheet analysis and monthly reconciliation of assigned entities.
• You prepare monthly, quarterly and year-end internal and group reports.
• You provide monitoring of costs, accruals and provisions in collaboration with the controlling team and local teams.
• You participate in the annual budgeting process.
• You foresee the closing of general ledger accounts and financial reporting.
• You participate in the annual external audit process if required.
• You will work closely with the Financial Controllers team in this process.
• You will always work on a country or entity based in Western Europe.

To fulfil this role of GL Accountant, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

• You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting.
• You have a first experience as a GL Accountant.
• You have a strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
• You are fluent in English.
• You have a good knowledge of balance sheet analysis, monthly, quarterly, and yearly closing processes, IFRS, and reconciliations.
• SAP experience is advantageous.
• You are a team player who thrives in an international environment.

For our client, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE.The company specializes in both small and large renovation projects throughout West Flanders. They handle full A-to-Z renovations as well as smaller works such as bathroom renovations, mainly for private clients, with occasional assignments for companies and organizations.

As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, your tasks include:
• Assisting with paving, small renovations, and indoor works
• Preparing renovation works (measuring, basic demolition, preparing materials)
• Installing plasterboard (gyproc), small masonry tasks, and simple carpentry
• Assisting with floor and tile installation and basic interior finishing
• Supporting full renovation projects from A to Z
• Preparing materials, assisting with installation, finishing, and site cleanup
As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, you recognize yourself in the following:

• You have initial experience as a renovation worker
• You speak Dutch or English
• You are not afraid of physical work

For our client in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a motivated GROUNDWORKER.

Our client is a highly driven company with 125 years of experience, specialized in earthworks and the installation of pipelines and landscaping for cities and municipalities.

As a CONSTRUCTION WORKER in the VEURNE region, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

• Sewer installation works
• Installing curbstones and edging
• Construction of cycle paths, roads, and parking areas
• Laying environmental pavement solutions
• Installation of roundabouts and traffic islands
• Laying paving stones and sidewalk tiles
• Small to large-scale earthworks
 

As a GROUNDWORKER in the VEURNE region, you can identify yourself in the following profile:

• You speak Dutch, English, or French fluently;
• You have relevant experience in road construction;
• You hold a valid driving licence B (additional licences are a plus);
• You are able to travel to the company independently (not accessible by public transport);
• You are practical, hands-on, and enjoy working outdoors.
